featured_reviews.name: Rajat Bajaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited PVR Icon at Phoenix Palladium Mall, Lower Parel to watch the intense and gripping film *Tere Ishq Mein*, and the overall experience turned out to be truly awesome. From the moment we entered, the theatre carried a premium feel that perfectly matched the high-octane mood of the movie. The cleanliness was impressive, with spotless floors, fresh seats, and a well-maintained auditorium that immediately made us comfortable.

The atmosphere was classy and inviting, exactly what one expects from an ICON-format cinema. The lighting, décor, and overall layout added a modern, upscale touch to the outing. The sound quality was excellent, enhancing every emotional beat and intense moment of Tere Ishq Mein, Dialogues were crisp, background score was immersive, and the action-heavy scenes carried real impact. The seats were comfortable, spacious, and well-cushioned, allowing us to enjoy the long movie without any discomfort.

What added to the joy was that it was a perfect Sunday outing. After the movie, we explored Phoenix Palladium — always lively, beautifully maintained, and full of great options for shopping and food. Being from North India, we naturally gravitated to Punjab Grill for lunch, and it turned out to be a wonderful choice. The food was rich, flavourful, and truly reminded us of home. The combination of delicious North Indian dishes and the mall’s vibrant ambience made the outing even more memorable.

In short, our visit to PVR Icon at Phoenix Palladium was a fantastic experience. The movie was intense, the theatre offered top-notch comfort and quality, and the day ended perfectly with a satisfying meal and a relaxed stroll through the mall. A Sunday well spent.

featured_reviews.name: Ganesh Rajak
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing experience at PVR Phoenix Palladium Mall! The luxurious Recliner seats, crystal-clear clean quality, and immersive sound system made the movie experience absolutely premium. One of the Best theatres in Mumbai !! ✨

featured_reviews.name: Veikho Asanii
featured_reviews.review_text:
For a change of pace and to explore something new, I caught a late-night movie at the PVR ICON (with Dolby Atmos) in Phoenix Palladium Mall, Lower Parel. It was a fantastic deal!
From the spacious lobby to the neat and well-maintained theatre, this place really stands out compared to other PVR locations I've visited. They offer a great variety of food items and excellent coffee options.
The seating—from sofa-style loungers to premium theatre seats—felt more like luxury, and in some ways, it was even better than the Gold Class Premier screens at other PVRs.
One standout observation: the sound engineer must be incredibly skillful. This delivered the best audio experience I've ever had in a PVR theatre—the Dolby Atmos immersion was top-notch!
Highly recommended place for anyone looking for a premium movie outing. Definitely worth it!

featured_reviews.name: Rajat Bajaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
On a rainy Sunday, I visited Nakshatra Mall in Dadar West and the experience was quite pleasant. Located conveniently near Shivaji Park, the mall is easy to reach and offers a cozy escape from the rains. Though not as large as some of the newer malls in the city, Nakshatra Mall has its own charm with a compact layout and a good mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment options.

The mall houses a variety of retail outlets, including popular apparel and lifestyle stores, making it a convenient spot for casual shopping. It also has a few branded showrooms where one can find both everyday wear and festive collections. What I particularly liked was that the mall wasn’t overcrowded, which made the shopping experience more comfortable, especially on a rainy day when people usually prefer indoor activities.

The food court and small eateries provide enough options for a quick bite, from snacks to proper meals. The seating area was neat, and the service was reasonably quick. The cinema hall inside the mall is another highlight, offering a good option to catch a movie while spending time indoors.

Overall, Nakshatra Mall may not be very big, but it is well-maintained, convenient, and a good weekend hangout spot.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Citylight Cinema for a Sunday evening show recently. Overall, the theatre experience was actually not bad. For around ₹400, we got two tickets for a weekend evening show, which felt quite reasonable. The theatre was also pretty packed, so clearly a lot of people visit this place regularly.

The main disappointment was the food section. They had a large variety of items displayed on the menu screens, but most of them were not available. Only popcorn, samosas, nachos, and a paneer tikka sandwich were being served. Nothing else from the menu seemed available.

If you’re displaying so many food options, especially during a busy weekend evening show when people are likely to snack more, the counters should be better stocked. It creates unnecessary disappointment when customers see multiple items advertised but can’t actually order them.

Overall: decent theatre experience and fair ticket pricing, but the food availability definitely needs improvement.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I came across this beautiful Nandi Bull Statue near Plaza Cinema in Dadar East. It’s a striking and culturally symbolic statue that represents strength, patience, and devotion in Indian mythology. The statue is beautifully crafted and placed right in the middle of a bustling area, making it a peaceful yet eye-catching spot.

It adds a unique charm to the area and is perfect for a quick photo stop while exploring Dadar. The surrounding area is lively with theatres, local shops, and classic Mumbai street vibes. A great example of tradition blending with city life.

Tip: Visit in the evening when the traffic calms down a bit, and the lighting makes the statue look even more majestic.

featured_reviews.name: Nishad Shahasane
featured_reviews.review_text:
Plaza Cinema is one of Mumbai’s oldest and most famous movie halls, located in the heart of Dadar, just a 5-minute walk from Dadar Station and near Shivsena Bhavan.

It’s a single-screen theatre with around 800 seats and a classic, nostalgic charm. The screen is big, the sound is good, and the hall is clean. Facilities include clean washrooms, drinking water, and parking for cars and bikes (no roadside parking).

Snacks are slightly expensive but easily available. The place is usually crowded, which adds to its lively atmosphere. There is a bus stop nearby named "Plaza" from where you can find BEST buses to various locations across Mumbai.

Overall, Plaza Cinema offers a good, old-school movie experience at affordable prices — a must-visit for anyone who loves vintage theatres.

featured_reviews.name: Stringzzz
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Metro INOX Cinema, and my overall experience was extremely enjoyable and comfortable. This cinema hall perfectly blends a classic feel with modern movie-watching amenities, making it a great choice for both regular viewers and cinema lovers who appreciate a well-maintained theatre.

The screen and sound quality were excellent. The visuals were sharp, bright, and immersive, which made the movie even more engaging. The sound system was well balanced—loud enough to create impact without being overwhelming. Dialogues were clear, and background music and effects were crisp, enhancing the overall cinematic experience.

The seating arrangement deserves special mention. The seats were comfortable, well-spaced, and offered a clear view of the screen from almost every angle. Legroom was sufficient, allowing for a relaxed experience even during a long movie. The auditorium was clean and well maintained, which added to the comfort level.

The ambience of Metro INOX has a pleasant and premium feel. The lobby area was neat, organized, and not overly crowded. The lighting and interiors give a classy vibe, making the wait time before the show quite comfortable. Entry and exit were well managed, avoiding unnecessary rush or confusion.

Food and beverages were also satisfactory. The snacks counter offered the usual cinema favourites like popcorn, cold drinks, and nachos. While prices are on the higher side—as expected in multiplexes—the quality and freshness were good. The staff at the counter were polite and quick in handling orders, even during peak hours.

Another positive aspect was the staff behavior and overall management. The staff members were helpful, courteous, and ensured smooth operations throughout the show. Ticket checking, seating guidance, and cleanliness were handled efficiently. Restrooms were clean and well maintained, which is an important factor for any public place.

Overall, Metro INOX Cinema provides a reliable, comfortable, and enjoyable movie-watching experience. Whether you’re going for a weekend show with friends, a family outing, or a solo movie break, this place delivers on quality, comfort, and ambience. I would definitely recommend Metro INOX Cinema to anyone looking for a pleasant and hassle-free cinema experience.

Location
We are simply used to visiting the usual places with easy access so something that slightly deviates from the pattern may seem out of the way and one may feel that way about Sitara Studio but its not the case.
It is an approximately seven minutes walk from Elphinstone Road Railway station.
By car  the two landmarks that you need to look out for are first the Indiabulls tower and second, the Congress party  "white house".
There is usually  an usher standing in the bylane  with a sign guiding people in so you don't miss.

Events : One can watch all sorts of performances here.. I have personally watched  plays and dance performances.
The fun part of this studio is that the sitting and the performances areas can be changed as per the performance.  So its brilliant for artists who can desgin a performance withouth worrying too much about a fixed stage structure.
There have been workshops here as well. In the performance area  as well as in an upper room which is spacious enough for a workshop of twenty people.

No cafe and I don't remember seeing any greta eateries around so this is a place where you can only go to watch a performance and perhaps go to Phoenix mills for your meals.

featured_reviews.review_text:
My recent experience at the MSRTC Shivneri Bus Stand in Dadar left me with mixed feelings. While the overall service of the Shivneri buses remains commendable, the facilities at the bus stand itself are in dire need of improvement, particularly when it comes to providing adequate shelter and comfort for passengers.

On a rainy day, I found myself at the MSRTC Shivneri Bus Stand, eagerly waiting for my bus. Unfortunately, my anticipation was quickly dampened, both literally and figuratively, as the facility failed to offer proper protection from the elements. The absence of sufficient shelter made it difficult for passengers to find a dry spot to stand or sit, leaving many of us exposed to the rain. It was disheartening to see elderly passengers and families with children struggling to stay dry while waiting for their buses.

The lack of proper infrastructure at the bus stand was evident. The limited seating arrangements were inadequate for the number of passengers present, and those available were often wet due to the rain. There were no covered waiting areas or even basic shelters to shield passengers from the weather. This situation is particularly concerning during the monsoon season when rain is frequent and heavy in Mumbai. A bus stand as busy and important as Dadar's Shivneri should certainly prioritize the comfort and convenience of its passengers by providing better infrastructure.

Despite these shortcomings, there are several positive aspects to note about the MSRTC Shivneri Bus Stand. The staff at the stand were courteous and helpful, assisting passengers with their queries and providing timely updates about bus arrivals and departures. The ticketing process was efficient, and I appreciated the digital screens displaying real-time information about bus schedules. This helped in reducing the anxiety of waiting, as passengers could see exactly when their buses were expected to arrive.

Additionally, the cleanliness of the bus stand was maintained reasonably well. Despite the rain, the staff made efforts to keep the area free of litter, which is commendable. The security presence was also reassuring, ensuring that passengers felt safe while waiting for their buses.

However, the positive aspects cannot entirely overshadow the critical need for better facilities. For an otherwise excellent service like Shivneri, enhancing the infrastructure at the Dadar bus stand is essential. Investing in covered waiting areas, more seating, and improved drainage systems to prevent waterlogging would greatly enhance the passenger experience, especially during the rainy season.

In conclusion, while the MSRTC Shivneri Bus Stand in Dadar excels in terms of service efficiency, cleanliness, and staff courtesy, it falls short in providing basic facilities to protect passengers from adverse weather conditions. Addressing these issues will ensure that passengers have a comfortable and pleasant experience, regardless of the weather.

featured_reviews.name: Divyansh Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the privilege of attending the Dada Saheb Phalke Award ceremony at Ravindra Theatre in Mumbai, and I must say, it was an exhilarating experience! The energy in the room was palpable, and despite the large crowd, the organizers managed everything seamlessly. What impressed me particularly was the cleanliness and maintenance of the washrooms, which is often a concern at large events.

The newly constructed theatre is a stunning addition to Mumbai's cultural scene, and I felt honored to be a part of such a significant event. The ceremony was well-organized, and the attendees were treated with respect and care.

If you're a fan of theatre and cinema, Ravindra Theatre seems like a fantastic venue to visit. I would highly recommend it for its grandeur, excellent management, and memorable experiences.

Excellent Event Management*: The organizers handled the large crowd efficiently, ensuring a smooth experience for attendees.

Cleanliness*: The washrooms were spotless and well-maintained, which added to the overall positive experience.

Beautiful Theatre*: The newly constructed building is impressive and provides a wonderful setting for cultural events.

High Energy*: The atmosphere was electric, making the event even more memorable.

featured_reviews.review_text: Had a nice experience of watching a live play show Eka Lagnachi Pudhchi Ghosta… Just loved the Auditorium.. It has good parking space..Huge waiting area and a neat clean auditorium.. Show was on time with perfect lights sound . It has huge seating capacity of more than 100 in two types lower and balcony category.. Would surely recommend a place to watch live plays♥️

featured_reviews.name: Kuldip Deshmukh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ravindra Natya Mandir stands out as one of the better-maintained cultural venues in the heart of Mumbai. The cleanliness and upkeep of the premises are truly commendable – a refreshing change from many other public places in the city.

The auditorium is well-designed, with good acoustics, a spacious stage, and comfortable seating, making it an ideal venue for drama and cultural performances. It delivers a quality viewing experience whether you’re in the front row or seated further back.

The canteen offers standard food options similar to other venues across Mumbai – decent but definitely an area that could be improved with more variety or better quality.

Parking is available, but like most places in Mumbai, it’s a bit tight and fills up quickly. Arriving early usually ensures a spot.

All in all, Ravindra Natya Mandir is a great venue for drama and cultural events – clean, accessible, and functional. Highly recommended for theatre lovers looking for a quality experience in the city.

The coffee was so bad and not what I had ordered. The coffee was replaced---but even that was lackluster and very tasteless. Complained to the manager--chandresh-- who was not trained well enough to address the situation.

After charging so exhorbitantly( for just popcorn, coffee n samosas )---it is a shame that such sub standard food is served to patrons. I am a very tolerant person,  and rarely complain--but this was too much of cheating of customers.

Truly upset and disappointed with PVR.  The relevant authorities need to check their kitchen.  Been to many PVR  theaters before,  including this one---and although the food was never great, it was atleast not so blatantly bad.

​I recently visited this location and was very pleased with the overall experience. The first thing I noticed was how clean and well-maintained the entire establishment is. The lobby, common areas, and especially the auditorium itself were all spotless, which immediately makes for a better visit. The seating was comfortable, allowing for a relaxed viewing experience.

​If you are looking for a reliable, decent theatre that provides a high-quality visual and audio experience, this is a solid choice. Highly recommended for a satisfying movie night out!
